Under the European Commission's EU AI Act guidelines, providers of general-purpose AI models that are released under a free and open-source licence are exempted from the following obligations:

1. The obligation to draw up and keep up-to-date the technical documentation of the model (Article 53(1), point (a)).
2. The obligation to draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information and documentation to providers of AI systems who intend to integrate the general-purpose AI model into their AI systems (Article 53(1), point (b)).

However, they must still fulfil the following obligations:

1. Put in place a policy to comply with Union law on copyright and related rights (Article 53(1), point (c)).
2. Draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary about the content used for training of the general-purpose AI model (Article 53(1), point (d)).

These exemptions do not apply if the model is classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk.
